profile.headline: Robotics Engineer
profile.summary: I am a robotics engineer. My PhD work focused on perception, tracking, and state estimation. Specifically, I worked on robotic perception under cluttered and challenging weather conditions for self-driving vehicles.

positions.title: PHD Graduate Student
positions.description: Skills: Linux · PyTorch · Git · MATLAB · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Laser Converting Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Performed PLC and human machine interface programming, along with drive configuration
 of a linear actuator for laser manufacturing applications. Driving the unit cost of product down by 75%. 
• Designed and implemented a vision and positioning system for automated robotic transportation 
 of raw materials, which would increase productivity and safety.

positions.title: Product Supply: Family Care Manufacturing Intern
positions.description:
• Reduced efficiency loss on production line by 1% by improving papermaking centerlines,
 resulting in an estimated savings of $80,000 a year. 
• Reduced the time of a part change from 6.5 hours to 4.5 hours by utilizing product flow 
 and effort balance diagrams, as well as organizational tools. 
• Led justification and $100,000 budgetary pricing for acquisition of automatic valves. 
• Aided redesign of core bins by observing defects in order to improve safety.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Student
positions.description:
• Engineered and synthesized self-assembling protein loaded nanoparticles as therapy for Osteoarthritis.
• Surveyed the size of more than 15 batches of nanoparticles using a dynamic light scattering device. 
• Measured over a 150 samples of nanoparticles for a degradation study over periods of 2 weeks.
• Increased retention of protein from a half-life of 0.63 days to 2.5 days with the nanoparticles.

organizations.name: Society of Hispanic Professional Engineers
organizations.position: Internal Fundraising Chair, Member · Aug 2012 - Present
organizations.description:
• Wrote, submitted, and presented a bill for over $1000 to our student government.
• Led the national conference registration and travel reimbursements for 20 students.
